resolutions.researcher_notes: The only dated sourcing found for the pipeline's origin conflicts with the sheet's 1974: English Wikipedia says the five-country agreement to form the pipeline company was reached in 1973 (matching the seed NYT citation 'Five Arab States Agree on Company For Sumed Pipeline,' dated 1973-12-12), and Arabic Wikipedia cites Egyptian Law No. 7 of 1974 establishing the operating company domestically. Neither is clearly 'proposal' in the GEM sense and they point to two different years, so per rule 7 I am not citing either as support for 1974 specifically. Left UNRESOLVED rather than force a mismatched date.

English Wikipedia: 'running from the Ain Sokhna terminal in the Gulf of Suez, the northernmost terminus of the Red Sea' — supports FuelSource/origin = Gulf of Suez. Arabic Wikipedia says the same thing but is the same underlying article/topic in another language edition, so this counts as one source per rule 6 -> medium, independent=false.

English Wikipedia's location table and prose both give 'From: Ain Sokhna terminal' on the Gulf of Suez, matching StartLocation='Ain Sukhna terminal'. Only one independent source found (Arabic Wikipedia is the same article/topic in another language, not a second independent source per rule 6) -> medium, independent=false.
